newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India off slightly in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India off slightly in thin trading.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts drifted in sluggish trading Friday, ending slightly lower in sympathy with local markets.
Traders said investors were sitting on the sidelines, waiting for stimulus from India.
In Bombay, a six-day rally ended when speculators took profits on the last day of weekly trade accounts. Bombay stocks had risen some five percent in six straight sessions.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.44 points off at 82.66, with the premium over the local market at 26.16 percent from 26.55 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index closed down 37.41 points at 3,836.44.
Telco ended down 12 cents at $11.75/$12.75 and Hindalco lost 50 cents to $32.50/$33.50.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index gained 0.84 points to 75.06 points, a premium of 42.78 percent over the local market. Trading in Seoul was closed for a holiday.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index gained 1.98 points, or 1.66 percent, to 121.71, representing a discount to the local market of 3.07 percent.
Taiwan GDRs were helped by strong sentiment in the high-tech sector.
